description: This header file defines the AccessChecker class, which implements the IAccessChecker interface. It declares methods to perform access control checks such as read, write, and path write access within the Kuksa-Vale project.

classes.name: AccessChecker
classes.description: Class implementing access control logic for the Kuksa-Vale server, specifically handling authorization checks using an IAuthenticator.

methods.name: AccessChecker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AccessChecker with an IAuthenticator.

methods.name: checkReadAccess
methods.description: Checks if read access is permitted for the given channel and path.

methods.name: checkWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks if write access is permitted for the given channel and path.

methods.name: checkPathWriteAccess
methods.description: Checks write access for multiple paths provided in a JSON array.
